summary: Adds an n_SV==0 guard that avoids the division-by-zero when building dual_coef_indptr, setting dual_coef_ to an empty sparse matrix exactly as the issue expects. Correct, minimal, matches the documented expected result.

No inline comment explaining why the empty-support-vector case needs special handling; a one-line note would aid future maintainers. Nit only.
